name: drizzle-e2e-pg
description: Baked dependency set for the pg drizzle-e2e lane. The packages UNDER TEST (@mionjs/drizzle-orm*, @mionjs/bin-compiler) are NOT here: each run installs them from the in-container verdaccio, so the lane exercises the published tarballs. dockerode and get-port are load-bearing no-ops — pg-common.ts imports them at the top level for a docker helper the lane never reaches, because it sets PG_CONNECTION_STRING instead.
